outcome: ease and difficulty of IUD removal
cohort: The study included 869 women aged 14-51 years who requested intrauterine device (IUD) removal.
finding: Difficult IUD removals were associated with IUD use duration of 3 years or more and previous cesarean delivery, though overall IUD removal was found to be an easy and safe procedure.
mod_finding: For each previous cesarean delivery, the risk of difficult IUD removal increased by 1.5 times.
